venture.name: Carella’s Kitchen
venture.concept: Mobile food truck offering convenient fitness-oriented meals with measured portions and visible calories and macros.
venture.products: Chicken and rice bowls, ground beef bowls, pasta, protein bars and shakes.
venture.customers: Adults 18–35, initially Fairfield-area college students and nearby gym members who want convenient, filling meals and clear nutrition information.
venture.value_proposition: Simple ingredients, customizable portions, clear calories and macros, and reasonably priced protein-forward meals.
venture.geography: Fairfield, Connecticut initially; original broad concept listed North America.
venture.channels: Food truck; exact stops, hours and ordering methods not specified.
venture.features: Measured portions, customizable protein and other ingredients, nutrition labels, variety of sauces and seasonings; potential gluten-free and dairy-free choices.

comparison.scope: Three representative chicken-and-rice bowls with listed prices; mixed ordering channels, before taxes and fees; different ingredients and portions.

recommendation.rationale: Near the sample’s $13.95 median, between the $12.75 Chipotle delivery listing and $15.93 CAVA delivery listing; use measured portions and macro labels to support value. Confirm costs and local customer willingness to pay.

limitations: Only three representative prices are comparable enough for a rough directional comparison; portions, protein amounts and ingredients vary.
Reefshack listing was last crawled four months ago; confirm directly before relying on it.
Chipotle and CAVA are third-party delivery listings and can differ from in-store prices; taxes, delivery and service fees are excluded.
Clean Slate menu has no displayed prices.
Regular prices, promotions, paid customizations, exact portion weights and complete macro information were not independently established.
Pricing changes; observed listings do not establish an optimal or profitable price.
